Ref No: PNC/SE/74/26-27    
 
 
 
 
 
Date: 29.10.2026 
 
To, 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The Manager 
Department of Corporate Services 
BSE Limited 
Floor 25, P.J. Towers, 
Dalal Street, Mumbai-400 001 
Scrip code:539150 
 
To, 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The Manager 
Listing Department 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza, BandraKurla Complex, 
Bandra (East), Mumbai-400 051 
NSE Symbol: PNCINFRA 
Dear Sir, 
Sub: Audio recording of earning conference call held with Investors and Analysts to discuss 
the financial results for the Quarter & Half Year ended September 30, 2026 
 
In continuation to our letter dated 22nd October, 2026 we hereby pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 
of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 inform you that 
the audio recording of the conference call held with Investors and Analysts on October 29, 2026 to 
discuss the un-audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of the Company for the 
quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This can be accessed via following link. 
 
https://www.pncinfratech.com/mp3/audio-recording-q2fy27-earnings-call.mp3 
 
The transcript for the said call will be shared with the Stock Exchanges and will also be uploaded 
on the Company’s website (https://www.pncinfratech.com/)in due course. 
 
This is for your information and records.  
 
Thanking you, 
For PNC Infratech Limited 
 
Tapan Jain 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
M. No.: A22603 
 
Tapan 
Jain
Digitally signed 
by Tapan Jain 
Date: 2026.10.29
